data.name: Sumant Dharkar
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Sumant Dharkar has made a big mark in cricket. With 33 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 44*, with an average of 13.76 and a quick strike rate of 99.66. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 4 sixes and 30 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 90.2 overs, taking 28 wickets at an economy rate of 10.06. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
